overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: although a quorum of the Council attended a September 8 community meeting and several Councilors spoke, they did not deliberate, since they received the same treatment as other public commenters.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the Council deliberated on the Roosevelt Park plan at a Sept. 8 community meeting where Councilors spoke as members of the public.
allegations.key_passage: After reviewing the video recording of the Community Meeting, we find that the Councilors did not deliberate during the Community Meeting, and, therefore, the Council did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
